name: wattle
description: Pages + Cards workspace that merges chat and file system, per spec1.md

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @wattle/api" "npm run dev -w @wattle/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wattle/shared && npm run build -w @wattle/prompt-engine && npm run build -w @wattle/api && npm run build -w @wattle/web
